scope: 60 distinct repositories; targeted reading of 120 file paths at pinned commits, not whole-repository audits or runtime evaluations.
selection: Official project repositories and established maintainer repositories with directly relevant instructions, implementation, testing or evaluation evidence. Stars are recorded as context, not a quality score.
limitations: Repository instructions describe intended practice; implementation snippets and tests provide narrower evidence. Neither proves universal compliance.
Related projects and forks are not statistically independent observations.
Only listed line ranges were reviewed; no claim to have read every fetched file in full.
No third-party projects were installed or executed. Selected public distribution repositories do not expose the complete proprietary tool implementation.
Zed AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are symlinks to .rules; Agno AGENTS.md is a symlink to CLAUDE.md. There are 120 reviewed paths and 119 distinct resolved files. Ranges refer to resolved content.
Line ranges are inclusive, normalized and clamped to the last non-trailing line.
